### O88202 — 60 kDa lysophospholipase
- Organism: Rattus norvegicus
- Reviewed: True
- Source: local_uniprot_swissprot_xml
- Homology: identity=100.0%, query coverage=100.0%, target coverage=100.0%, E-value=0
- Exact reference sequence hash match: yes
- function: Exhibits lysophospholipase, transacylase, PAF acetylhydrolase and asparaginase activities (PubMed:10320809, PubMed:8119970, PubMed:9575212). Can catalyze three types of transacylation reactions: (1) acyl transfer from 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine (1-acyl-GPC) to the sn-1(3) positions of glycerol and 2-acylglycerol (sn-1 to -1(3) transfer), (2) acyl transfer from 1-acyl-GPC to the sn-2 positions of 1-acyl-GPC, 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine (1-acyl-GPE), and other lysophospholipids (sn-1 to -2 transfer) and (3) acyl transfer from 2-acyl-GPC to the sn-1 position of 2-acyl-GPC and 2-acyl-GPE (sn-2 to -1 transfer) (PubMed:10320809). Mediates the synthesis of 1-arachidonoyl species of phospholipids by transferring the arachidonoyl residue from 2-arachidonoyl lysophospholipid to the sn-1 position of 2-acyl lysophospholipid (PubMed:10320809).

entities.name: 60 kDa lysophospholipase
observations: The 564-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed rat UniProt O88202, with 100% identity and coverage.
Curated annotations report lysophospholipase, transacylase, PAF acetylhydrolase, and asparaginase activities; the protein is monomeric.
Pfam identifies an N-terminal Asparaginase domain (PF00710, residues 11-219) and Asparaginase_C domain (PF17763, residues 237-345), plus C-terminal ankyrin-repeat-like regions.

source_tools.relevance: Exact sequence match and curated functional annotations

entities.name: L-asparagine hydrolysis
observations: Curated Rhea mapping RHEA:21016 supports hydrolysis of L-asparagine to L-aspartate and ammonium: L-asparagine + H2O = L-aspartate + NH4(+).
This reaction is consistent with the query's conserved Asparaginase and Asparaginase_C domains.

entities.name: Lysophospholipid deacylation
observations: Curated Rhea mapping RHEA:15177 supports hydrolysis of 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine to sn-glycerol 3-phosphocholine and a fatty acid.
Related curated reactions include hydrolysis of 2-acyl phosphatidylcholine (RHEA:44696), 1-acyl phosphatidylethanolamine (RHEA:32967), and platelet-activating factor (RHEA:17777).

entities.name: Phospholipid transacylation
observations: Curated annotation reports acyl transfer among lysophospholipids, including transfer from 1-acyl-GPC or 2-acyl-GPC to glycerol, acylglycerols, phosphatidylcholine, phosphatidylethanolamine, and other lysophospholipids.
The enzyme can mediate formation of 1-arachidonoyl phospholipid species by transferring arachidonoyl groups between lysophospholipids.
